title: Ribbon gallery
description: A woodblock print separates into narrow, twisting ribbons before the next edition becomes whole.
useCase: Give a finite art or image transition a dimensional material gesture while preserving a readable resting image.
interaction: Drag left across the print or select the next and previous controls.

assets.description: Flowering plum branch with a red sky

reducedMotion: Prints change instantly without ribbon deformation. Keyboard navigation is immediate.
limitations: Native WebGL 1 with a static image fallback if unsupported or context is lost. Supplied art images are CC0.
look: Near-black gallery with a centred Japanese woodblock print, small spaced monospace labels, a cream serif title and two outlined circular arrow buttons.
motion: Arrows or a leftward drag split the print into 26 ribbons that ripple and twist in perspective as a wavy wipe reveals the next image, smoothstep-eased over 650 ms.
adapt: Ribbon deformation is the `VERTEX` shader (amplitudes `.16` and `.38`, scaled by `envelope`) over 26 `bands`; `FRAGMENT` draws the wipe and `transition` runs the 650 ms smoothstep tween. Replace `PRINTS` with your images; drags past 0.12 progress complete.
